params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines which fields are present in the response. `edit` requires authentication.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit to items published after a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit to items published before a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific ids.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific ids.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit result set to items with one or more specific slugs.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return, e.g. `id,slug,title,link`. Not declared in the route index but honoured globally by the WordPress REST controller; strongly recommended because full post bodies run to ~15 KB each.

params.name: mime_type
params.description: Limit to a specific MIME type, e.g. `application/pdf`.

items.docs: Returns the 99-item media library — press-release PDFs, poster and presentation decks, logos, Elementor screenshots and site imagery. Each item carries `source_url` and, for images, the generated size variants under `media_details.sizes`.
